change.after: "disabled by default, allowed only in specified namespace"

consequence.statement: Policy exceptions that were previously created in namespaces outside a specified exceptions namespace will no longer function as configured; operators must follow upgrade guidance to reconfigure exception namespace settings to maintain the same behavior.
consequence.remediation: Review the upgrade guidance provided in the release notes to reconfigure policy exception namespace settings. Audit existing PolicyException resources and migrate them to the allowed exceptions namespace as needed.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes the default behavior for policy exceptions: they are now disabled by default and can only be created in a specified namespace, whereas previously they were allowed in all namespaces.
